title: eludite.project.templates input
description: The installed `dotnet new` templates (brief 0072): the SDK's template packages, the user's installed ones and Eludite's built-in item templates, read by eludite-host (which starts if no workspace is open). Use it to find the `template` for eludite.project.new (type project) or eludite.project.add_item (type item). The list is cached per SDK; `refresh` reads it again.

type.description: project, item or solution; all when omitted.

language.description: Only templates in this language (C#, F#, VB) or language-neutral ones.

query.description: Only templates whose name, short name, description or classifications contain this, ignoring case.
